region_or_gene: 2q12.3 duplication (hg19 band; lies in 2q13 on GRCh38)
direction: duplication carriers HIGHER general cognitive ability
phenotype: general cognitive ability z (NVIQ / Moray House / FI / g-factor, z-scored within cohort)
study: Huguet G et al. 2024 Cell Genomics (CNV-GWAS, 258,292 general-population individuals)
effect: z=+0.434 (SOWAHC); +0.496 (SEPT10); +0.460 (EDAR/SH3RF3); dosage model +0.415 SD per copy (p=2.65e-3); reciprocal deletion z=-0.526 (p=0.058)
p: 7.58e-3 (SOWAHC; FDR q=0.0373); 3.46e-3 (SEPT10; q=0.0172); 8.63e-3 (EDAR/SH3RF3; q=0.0418); post-hoc UKB White-British t-test p=0.001
replicated: N - no independent replication found (EuropePMC forward citations checked 2026-09-23: 5 citing items, none re-tests the locus; Kazem 2026 UKB+All of Us functional-burden paper and Poulain 2025 UKB paper do not mention 2q12.3/EDAR/SH3RF3/SEPT10/SOWAHC)
uk_biobank_contributes: Y (UKB 238,176 of 258,292 = 92%; post-hoc test UKB White British only)
clingen_dosage: ClinGen gene curation (local file 2026-09-22): EDAR, SH3RF3, SEPTIN10, SOWAHC all UNCURATED; nearest region ISCA-37405 2q13 NPHP1 (TS=40) outside interval. Collins 2022 pTriplo (model-predicted): EDAR 0.197, SH3RF3 0.595, SEPT10 0.983, SOWAHC 0.343
notes: Only positive-effect CNV among all FDR-significant CNVs in Table S1 (all 6 deletions and other 6 duplications are negative). The reported FDR q<0.05 is lenient: each gene of multigenic CNVs is a separate, highly correlated test and ~120+ genes from known pathogenic CNVs contribute very small p-values; not Bonferroni-significant across 596 duplication genes (8.4e-5). CORRECTION for atlas: the atlas states no corrected p was found; Table S1 does report FDR q values (0.017-0.042). Tension: SEPT10 pTriplo 0.98 predicts duplication intolerance (disease-model prediction, not cognition data). Gene-level loss evidence is NOT support for duplication benefit: EDAR LoF causes hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia (DDG2P definitive); Sh3rf3 knockout mice show autism-like behaviour (Yuan 2025/2026 Mol Psychiatry) -- loss harmful does not imply gain beneficial. Genebass rare coding tests of all four genes vs FI/RT: all p>0.01 (no coding convergence). Median cohort age 60.7 y; authors raise 'neuroprotective' alternative. Winner's curse likely.
